question: If a permanent enters as a copy of a permanent that was cast with its impending cost, does it enter with time counters?

expected.shortAnswer: No: it does not enter with time counters, and it will be a creature.
expected.answer: If an object enters as a copy of a permanent that was cast with its impending cost, it won't enter with time counters, and it will be a creature.

whyHard: Impending changes how the original was cast, and players expect a copy to inherit the same state.
